pages.title: Astral Ore
pages.text: It glows faintly wherever the astral seeps into stone. It generates in the $(item)Astral Infection biome$(0) and must be mined with a diamond pickaxe.

pages.title: Refining
pages.text: Smelt the ore into $(item)Astral Ore Shards$(0). Three shards, one $(item)Astral Matrix$(0) (dropped by Astral Drakes), two diamonds and two gold ingots craft an $(item)Astral Ingot$(0).
